# Format Value

## Summary
A field value carries three representations: `serialize` produces the wire
JSON, `queryableValue` supplies what the search index stores and filters
on, and the format components render the value.

## Invariants
- `queryableValue` must be stable and comparable — formatted display
  strings do not sort/filter correctly; keep raw values queryable and
  format only at render.
- A field with custom `serialize` must deserialize its own output
  (round-trip law).

## Example
`PercentageField` demonstrates this: it stores `12.5`, queries as a number,
and renders `12.5%` — three representations of one value.

## Module
`https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` — exports `queryableValue`,
`getQueryableValue`, `formatQuery`.
